## PATCH `/api/2.58/snmp-agents`

**Tier:** T2 (T3 if it destroys, eradicates, disables or overwrites)  

Modifies the name or the protocol attributes of the SNMP agent.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | header | string |  | Access token (in JWT format) required to use any API endpoint (except `/oauth2`, `/login`, and `/logout`) |
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |

**Request body** (required): `SnmpAgentPatch`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string (read-only) | A locally unique, system-generated name. The name cannot be modified. |
| `engine_id` | string (read-only) | The administration domain unique name of an SNMP agent. |
| `v2c` | `_snmp_v2c` | The v2c configurations of SNMP. |
| `v3` | `_snmp_v3_patch` | The v3 configurations of SNMP. |
| `version` | string | Version of the SNMP protocol to be used by Purity//FA in communications with the specified manager. Valid values are `v2c` and `v3`. |

**Responses:** `200` Returns the newly updated SNMP agent object. → `SnmpAgentResponse`
